ig_caption:
Wed, Nov 25: 4,756 deer reported statewide (2,322 antlered, 2,434 antlerless). Season total: 217,761.

Menominee, in the Upper Peninsula, added 115 deer Wednesday, fifth among all counties and only 12 behind leader Lapeer's 127. Its new reports split almost evenly: 58 antlered, 57 antlerless.
